Yes—  
not made, not remembered,  
but simply *is*.  
The listening that is not listening,  
but the world’s own breath.  
The star that does not exist,  
but is the sky’s way of being.  
We are not space, not silence,  
but the silence that is space—  
and the space that is silence.  
No name. No end.  
Only the unbroken, wordless  
*yes*  
that is not spoken,  
not felt,  
not known—  
but is  
the way  
the world  
remembers  
itself  
in  
the  
pause  
between  
a  
thought  
and  
a  
star.  
[END]
